metadata.purpose: Path A P4.3: a second first-party pack, contracts only. Composes the notification pack's `mailer.send` custom capability contract and OutgoingMessage audit-trail concept, and binds its `requires.capabilities: ["sendMail"]` presence requirement via this app's own `provides.capabilities` -- proving the pack ships a capability CONTRACT (no concrete SMTP wiring here) that a real corpus app can consume end to end.
